decisions.reason: This metropolitan data-centre connectivity offer remains tightly aligned with the firm's cloud and infrastructure strategy, uses core network assets, and its early adoption means the option value of continuing is still high relative to exit.

Optical spectrum connectivity builds directly on the firm's owned fibre capabilities and high-bandwidth positioning, so management would keep it as a strategically important option unless clear evidence of weak demand emerged.

The voice number ordering portal is a relatively low-cost digital extension of the existing voice business, so it is worth keeping open, though its narrower strategic importance and likely learnings by now raise the chance of later withdrawal or integration.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product with weak fit to the firm's software-defined growth path, and after several years the uncertainty is sufficiently resolved that resources are better redeployed to core infrastructure and newer developments.
